request.description: Compile the protected two-joint MuJoCo model and measure deterministic 20 ms actuator impulse responses from representative elbow configurations.

measurements.label: initial compiled dynamics and response characterization

request.rationale: The initial decision is whether the first goal-directed intervention should address intrinsic torque authority and transient regulation or policy exposure/generalization. No learned candidate exists, so candidate evaluation cannot answer that distinction. This measurement directly records compiled inertial quantities, actuator limits and gear, configuration-dependent joint-space mass, and matched action-to-q/qvel/end-effector responses with one control-period impulses followed by zero input. Strong configuration dependence, large residual velocity, or weak decay would support a dynamics/regulation direction; well-damped, non-saturated responses would shift priority toward full official-radius exposure and later candidate evaluation.
